session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: Hi Tomas! I finally signed up for the beekeeping course I told you about.

session_1.speaker: Tomas
session_1.text: That is great news, Priya. When does it start?

session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: It starts next Tuesday evening at the community allotment near my office.

session_1.speaker: Tomas
session_1.text: Nice. I have been busy building a telescope from a kit in my flat, so I am a bit jealous of your free evenings.

session_1.speaker: Tomas
session_1.text: Slowly. The tube arrived yesterday and I am varnishing the wooden stand this weekend.

session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: A varnished stand sounds lovely. Send me a photo when it is finished!

session_1.speaker: Tomas
session_1.text: I will. Good luck with the first lesson.

session_2.speaker: Tomas
session_2.text: Hey Priya, how was your first beekeeping lesson?

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: It was nerve-racking but fun. I wore the full suit, and the teacher said I was too hasty with the smoker.

session_2.speaker: Tomas
session_2.text: Ha, that sounds like a good start. Did you meet anyone there?

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: Yes, a retired ferry captain named Oskar works the next hive over, and he gave me a few tips.

session_2.speaker: Tomas
session_2.text: I finished varnishing the stand last Sunday. The walnut stain turned out darker than I expected.

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: I would love to see it. Are you still planning the trip to the island in April?

session_2.speaker: Tomas
session_2.text: Yes, I booked the ferry for the second weekend of April. I want to walk the lighthouse path.

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: Take a warm coat. The weather out there is unpredictable.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Good morning Tomas! Did you get back from the island?

session_3.speaker: Tomas
session_3.text: Yes, last night. The walk was wonderful, although it was foggy for two hours, so your advice about the coat was right.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: I am glad you were prepared. I opened my first hive this week and found the queen.

session_3.speaker: Tomas
session_3.text: That is a big moment. Are you going to keep taking the course?

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Definitely. I signed up for the advanced beekeeping course that starts in May.

session_3.speaker: Tomas
session_3.text: Then I owe you a visit. I want to see the hives and show you the telescope.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Come over on the last Saturday of April. I will cook dinner.

session_3.speaker: Tomas
session_3.text: It is a date. I will bring dessert.

qa.question: What did Priya sign up for?
What is Tomas building from a kit?
Who did Priya meet at the beekeeping course?
When did Tomas plan to travel to the island?
What did Priya find when she opened her first hive?
What course did Priya sign up for next?
qa.answer: The advanced beekeeping course starting in May
